checks.title: Recovery after plugin/application reload
checks.mode: Real persisted staging, reloaded plugin, recovery command and real caption modal DOM handler

details.reloadProof: Loaded plugin object no longer carries pre-reload token; exact application reload method is recorded by root.

checks.title: Final record and staging audit
checks.mode: Actual audit command plus independent filesystem assertions

details.noticeVisual: Root can verify visible notice; this check asserts command dispatch and filesystem counts.

limits: App API captureFiles calls use the actual loaded plugin, editor context and VaultIO; they are not native OS import or drop actions.
Caption controls are the real Obsidian modal DOM handlers activated programmatically; askDescription is never overridden.
Record-property synchronization is tested through a file edit; Bases UI cell editing is not asserted.
Note switching uses the workspace API while a real caption modal is open.
Recovery setup uses the real MediaStore.stage API; it does not simulate a native paste interruption.
